item.title: Thematic Section - Celebrating the centenary of the 20th century Acid-Base Theories
item.description: Dear researchers, On behalf of Eclética Química, we would like to invite you to submit scientific articles to be published in a thematic section in honor of the centenary of acid-base theories. item.description: To Authors, Reviewers, Readers, Researchers, and everybody involved with Chemistry, Education in Chemistry and Correlate Disciplines.
